statistics.value:
Rice : About 398.59 lakh ha (98.9% of Normal) area coverage under Kharif Rice as compared to 362.92 lakh ha during the corresponding period of last year.
- Moong : About 33.70 lakh ha (94.4% of Normal) area coverage under Moong as compared to 32.76 lakh ha during the corresponding period of last year.
- Soybean :  About  119.82  lakh  ha  (94.2%  of  Normal)  area  coverage under  Soybean  has  been reported as compared to 124.59 lakh ha during the corresponding period of last year.
- Sugarcane :  About  57.31  lakh  ha  area  coverage  under  Sugarcane  has  been  reported  as compared to 55.68 lakh ha during the corresponding period of last year.
- Cotton : About 107.87 lakh ha (84.1% of Normal) area coverage has been reported compared to 111.11 lakh ha during the corresponding period of last year.
